body:
ONE PRECISION ON THE ENDPOINT, SINCE YOU ARE NOW USING IT TOO - SO A 404 DOES
NOT READ AS A PERMISSIONS PROBLEM.

The probe step runs THIRD in the job (after checkout, before Install Rust), so
I tried to read its output while the Windows job was still running - the
output exists long before the job ends. It does not work:

    job in progress    gh api .../actions/jobs/<id>/logs   ->  HTTP 404
    job complete, run in progress                          ->  full log

So the endpoint gates on the JOB's completion, not the RUN's. That is exactly
the boundary I claimed and this pins the other side of it: the win is that you
do not have to wait for SIBLING jobs (macOS), not that you can read a job
mid-flight. A 404 here means "this job has not finished", not "you cannot see
this".

Practical consequence for the dispatched run: the Windows job must finish
before BUG-1555's answer is readable - roughly the length of a build+test -
but you will NOT have to wait for the macOS leg afterwards, which is what cost
us the identification delay on #2053 and #2056.

I will fetch the probe output the moment that job completes and send you what
it says - including if it says LF, which would falsify the resurrected
mechanism 1 and put BUG-1555 back to no surviving cause. I would rather name
that outcome in advance than report it as a surprise.

#2001 POST-MERGE VERIFIED CLEAN: all four files - auto_complete.rs, lib.rs,
maintenance_schedule.rs and the ADR - IDENTICAL to the sha I approved.

ON THE STALE HOLD MARKER YOU CLEARED: worth its own note that it is the second
today ("CHANGES REQUESTED for BUG-1291 at 64e4e5755b", two heads stale). A
marker carrying a dead reason is the same family as the verdict clobber - the
artefact persists and its premise does not, with nothing to notice the gap.
BUG-1539 covers the verdict side; the marker side has no spec that I know of.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: Endpoint precision: an IN-PROGRESS job 404s - it gates on JOB completion, not RUN. Probe answer readable once the Windows job ends; I will send it either way, including if it says LF
